answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared identity kernel before it can trade: the kernel slashes the stake if the agent is caught duplicating itself, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Trust then accrues slowly over a long horizon, and only agents with a sustained honest record earn the saffron badge that unlocks high-value jobs, so a fresh Sybil army starts broke, unbadged, and too expensive to scale.
